def upload(self, actor: str, reviewer_id: str, filename: str, content: bytes) -> dict:
        with self.bo_probe.span("upload_file", lambda: {"inputs": {
            "actor": actor, "reviewer_id": reviewer_id, "filename": filename, "size": len(content)}}) as activation:
            if not filename or len(filename) > 200 or len(content) > 10 * 1024 * 1024:
                raise DomainError("invalid_upload", 400)
            row = {"id": uuid.uuid4().hex, "uploader_id": actor, "reviewer_id": reviewer_id,
                "recipient_id": "", "filename": filename, "size": len(content), "content": content,
                "state": "new", "revision": 0, "journal": []}
            with self.store.bo_data.transaction("db_transaction", self.store.write_transaction()) as connection:
                if not self.authorize(connection, actor, "upload", row):
                    raise DomainError("upload_denied")
                transition = self.advance(row, "submit", True)
                self.store.insert_file(connection, row)
            self.bo_observer.state(row, "upload_file", transition)
            result = self.store.bo_data.transform("db_metadata", metadata_view, row,
                before=lambda value: {"size": value["size"]}, after=lambda value: {"size": value["size"]})
            activation.result(lambda: {"outputs": {"file_id": row["id"], "state": row["state"], "revision": row["revision"]}})
            return result

authorize_file.snippet:
def authorize(self, db, actor: str, operation: str, row: dict) -> bool:
        known = {user["id"] for user in self.store.read_users(db)}
        inputs = {"actor": actor, "uploader": row["uploader_id"], "reviewer": row["reviewer_id"],
            "recipient": row["recipient_id"], "logged_in": actor in known,
            "approved": row["state"] == "approved", "shared": bool(row["recipient_id"]),
            "pending": row["state"] == "pending", "withdrawn": row["state"] == "withdrawn",
            "reviewer_exists": row["reviewer_id"] in known}
        report = evaluate(self.policy, operation, inputs, {"same_identity": same_identity},
            fact_revision=row["id"] + ":" + str(row["revision"]), source_root=self.root)
        self.bo_observer.policy(report, row["id"])
        self.bo_probe.record("authorize_file", "decision", lambda: {
            "inputs": {"actor": actor, "operation": operation, "file_id": row["id"], "revision": row["revision"]},
            "outputs": {"allowed": report["value"] is True}})
        return report["value"] is True

state_transition.snippet:
def advance(self, row: dict, event: str, allowed: bool):
        with self.bo_probe.span("state_transition", lambda: {"inputs": {"event": event, "before": row["state"]}}) as activation:
            before = row["state"]
            result = self.workflow.step(before, event, file_context(row), allowed)
            row["state"], row["revision"] = result["state"], row["revision"] + 1
            row["journal"] = [*row["journal"], {"seq": row["revision"], "event": event, "before": before,
                "after": result["state"], "guards": result["guards"], "payload": result["payload"]}]
            activation.result(lambda: {"outputs": {"after": result["state"], "allowed": allowed}})
            return result

def migrate_file_states(self):
        """Atomically extend the original SQLite check without rewriting file facts."""
        with self.write_transaction() as db:
            definition = db.exec_driver_sql(
                "SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='files'").scalar_one()
            if "'withdrawn'" in definition:
                return
            custom = db.exec_driver_sql(
                "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE tbl_name='files' "
                "AND type IN ('index','trigger') AND sql IS NOT NULL").fetchall()
            if custom:
                raise RuntimeError("Custom file indexes/triggers require an explicit migration")
            migration_metadata = MetaData()
            users.to_metadata(migration_metadata)
            upgraded = files.to_metadata(migration_metadata, name="files_with_withdrawal")
            upgraded.create(db)
            columns = ", ".join('"' + column.name + '"' for column in files.columns)
            db.exec_driver_sql(f"INSERT INTO files_with_withdrawal ({columns}) SELECT {columns} FROM files")
            db.exec_driver_sql("DROP TABLE files")
            db.exec_driver_sql("ALTER TABLE files_with_withdrawal RENAME TO files")
            if db.exec_driver_sql("PRAGMA foreign_key_check").fetchall():
                raise RuntimeError("File state migration violated foreign keys")

def create_app(root: Path, database=None, bo_probe=None, bo_observer=None, bo_data=None):
    probe = bo_probe or NullProbe()
    app = Flask(__name__, template_folder=str(root / "templates"), static_folder=str(root / "static/app"))
    app.config.update(MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH=11 * 1024 * 1024, SESSION_COOKIE_HTTPONLY=True,
        SESSION_COOKIE_SAMESITE="Strict")
    secret_path = root / "var/session-secret"
    secret_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if not secret_path.exists():
        secret_path.write_bytes(secrets.token_bytes(32))
    app.secret_key = secret_path.read_bytes()
    store = Store(database or root / "var/team-files.sqlite3", bo_data)
    store.initialize()
    service = FileService(root, store, probe, bo_observer)
    routes = WebRoutes(app, service, probe)
    app.before_request(routes.before_request)
    app.after_request(routes.after_request)
    app.teardown_request(routes.teardown_request)
    app.register_error_handler(DomainError, routes.error)
    app.add_url_rule("/", "index", routes.index)
    app.add_url_rule("/login", "login", routes.login, methods=["POST"])
    app.add_url_rule("/logout", "logout", routes.logout, methods=["POST"])
    app.add_url_rule("/upload", "upload", routes.upload, methods=["POST"])
    app.add_url_rule("/files/<file_id>/review", "review", routes.review, methods=["POST"])
    app.add_url_rule("/files/<file_id>/share", "share", routes.share, methods=["POST"])
    app.add_url_rule("/files/<file_id>/withdraw", "withdraw", routes.withdraw, methods=["POST"])
    app.add_url_rule("/files/<file_id>", "file_info", routes.file_info)
    app.add_url_rule("/files/<file_id>/download", "download", routes.download)
    app.extensions.update(trial_store=store, trial_service=service)
    return app
